advisory is billed per day

cases.description: The ValueFlows process pattern retold as speech; inputs and outputs, plans, fulfilment and agents.
input: okay so um ValueFlows is basically built around processes and economic resources
a process has inputs and outputs and uh those are all economic events
each economic event has an action and it affects an economic resource
the resources they conform to a resource specification
and a process is based on a process specification
processes are planned within a plan and uh the plan includes commitments and intents
an economic event fulfills a commitment
and agents so persons and organizations they provide and receive the events

cases.description: The W3C Organization Ontology retold as speech; is-a chains, units, sites, posts and memberships.
input: right so the org ontology is about organizations um and the agents that work in them
a formal organization is a kind of organization and uh a business entity is a kind of formal organization
formal organizations have organizational units
an organization also has sites and one of them is its primary site
it has posts too and each post is held by an agent
and um the organization has memberships and each membership has a role
so basically an agent is a member of an organization

cases.description: SOSA and SSN retold as speech; kinds of system, observations, features of interest, platforms and deployments.
input: okay so the sensor network ontology um is about systems observations and features of interest
there are three kinds of systems sensors actuators and samplers
a sensor observes an observable property and uh it makes observations
each observation has a result and it's about a feature of interest
the feature of interest has properties and um observable properties are one kind of property
systems are hosted by platforms and a platform is used in a deployment
and each system implements a procedure
